name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain: battle turn flow). No address residue. Descriptor corrected from 'acted_or_asleep' to 'acted_or_incapacitated': the per-unit skip condition at runtime_char +0x26 is the PARALYSIS status flag (bStatus_paralysis_flag), not a sleep flag -- FD2 has no sleep pathology, so 'asleep' was a misnomer. 'incapacitated' covers the paralysed (and dead) unable-to-act cases; 'acted' covers the acted case. Aligns the name with the KB which already describes the gate as '死亡/已行動/麻痹'.
purpose: Detect end of the player phase: if every player unit has acted, is paralysed (incapacitated), or is dead, run the full turn cycle (enemy/NPC phase + new round) with the active-unit HUD panel suppressed during the transition.
logic_summary: all_done = 1. Loop char_iter over [0, data_fd2_battle_party_member_count): pChar = runtime_char base + char_iter*RUNTIME_CHAR_SIZE(0x50). If (pChar[5].flags & 0x81)==0 (neither dead bit0 nor acted bit7) AND pChar[6].team==TEAM_PLAYER(2) AND pChar[0x26].status_paralysis_flag==0, then an active/alive player unit still has a turn -> all_done = 0. The loop scans the whole party (no early break). If all_done: data_fd2_ui_play_active_flag=0 and data_fd2_battle_anim_phase=0 (suppress active-unit HUD / mark transition), call fd2_run_full_turn_cycle(), then restore data_fd2_battle_anim_phase=1 and data_fd2_ui_play_active_flag=1.

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effect: may invoke fd2_run_full_turn_cycle() (enemy/NPC phase) and toggles HUD/anim-phase globals around it.

notes: Caller: fd2_game_main_loop @ 0x117e7 (call site 0x11985), invoked after a player unit completes an action (post fd2_process_xp_and_level_up_for_char + per-chapter post-action handler) to decide whether the player phase should end. Field offsets verified against project struct runtime_char in src/include/types.h (+0x05 flags bit0=dead/bit7=acted, +0x06 team 2=player, +0x26 status_paralysis_flag), which is authoritative for this build; the fd2-knowledge guide layout is an 8-byte-shifted display mapping and was not used. RENAME (asleep -> incapacitated): the +0x26 field is the paralysis flag, not a sleep flag (FD2 has no sleep pathology per the 7d status-model finding), so 'asleep' was a misnomer; renamed to '..._incapacitated' and the src comment / plate updated to say paralysed. Six-face sync applied (Ghidra fn+plate, btl_turn.c def+plate, protos.h, menu.c call site, KB battle.md/ui_menu.md, code_emit routing + data_emit data_routing). Rename verified byte-equivalent by eqcheck.
